# Anupam Takshashila Vidyapith (ATV), Nirmali

> Bihar Government registered co-educational school in Nirmali, Supaul district, Bihar (PIN 847452), founded in 2020. CBSE-oriented curriculum, Hindi and English medium, Play School to Class VIII.

## Key facts
- Name: Anupam Takshashila Vidyapith (Hindi: अनुपम तक्षशिला विद्यापीठ; short: ATV Nirmali)
- Address: Ward No. 4, Chawal Mandi, Sharma Gali, Nirmali, Supaul, Bihar 847452, India
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/qR3qbDvkRSYq1WPu6 (26.310858, 86.575209)
- Phone: +91-9006308822, +91-8789724803 (WhatsApp: +91-8789724803)
- Email: atv.nirmali@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.atvnirmali.org
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/atv_nirmali/
- Bihar Government Registration No.: 20811012024118185825
- Director cum Principal: Sushil Kumar Sahu
- Classes: Play School, Nursery, LKG, UKG, Classes I–VIII
- School hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:30 AM–2:00 PM (office 9 AM–5 PM)
- Faculty: 12+ trained teachers; 100+ students

## What makes ATV different
- Smart classrooms, computer lab, library, sports ground, CCTV, school bus
- Preparation for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNVST), Sainik School (AISSEE), Rashtriya Military School, RIMC and R.K. Mission entrance exams, with a special batch for Classes V–VII
- IIT-IIM mentorship programme (mentors from IIT BHU, IIM Mumbai, IIM Bangalore and medical colleges), launched 2023–24
- 91% Olympiad success rate (as reported by the school)

## Fees (session 2026-27)
- Monthly tuition: Nursery–UKG ₹800, Classes I–V ₹900, Classes VI–VIII ₹1,000
- One-time charges at admission: ₹5,500
- Transport by distance: 0–5 km ₹600–₹800, 5–8 km ₹900, 8–10 km ₹1,100, 10–15 km ₹1,300, above 15 km ₹1,500 per month
- Scholarships for meritorious students based on the admission test
